title: Social Media Marketing Agency Dubai | The Brandle
description: Social media marketing in Dubai. Designed posts, captions, scheduling, replies and paid social on Instagram, LinkedIn and TikTok for a fixed monthly fee.

hub.name: Social media
hub.line: A feed that looks like one company made it.

hero.joke: Your feed shouldn't look like three different interns took turns. Even if they did.
hero.intro: A social media marketing agency in Dubai, run by designers. Content plans, designed posts, captions, scheduling, community replies and paid campaigns for Instagram, LinkedIn and TikTok, on a fixed monthly fee.

items.p: What you post, how often and why, agreed a month ahead. No more panicked posting on a Sunday night.
Templates and one-offs made by designers in your brand's type and colours. Not a stock template with your logo in the corner.
Everything queued and published at sensible times, so the feed runs while you run the business.
Comments and messages answered in your voice, with anything tricky passed to you.
A boost for what already works, and proper campaigns when there's something to sell.
A monthly page on what was posted, what people did and what we'll try next.

fit.p: Not every business needs to be on every platform. Two done well beats five done badly. We'll say which two, and whether the honest answer is none.
yes: Posting in bursts, then going quiet for a month
Running a feed that looks nothing like your website
Losing hours every week making content yourself
Selling something good that photographs badly
fit.no: what you want is leads from ads. That's [digital marketing](/services/digital-marketing/), and the two overlap less than people think. Nothing to post yet? Start with [brand identity](/services/brand-identity-design/).

items.p: A free call about the brand, the audience and what you've tried. You get a content plan and a fixed monthly quote.
We design and write the month's posts in one go and send them over for approval.
Approved content is scheduled and published. Replies are handled as they come in.
Monthly numbers, then the next plan is adjusted to match what worked.

price.p: Priced by how many platforms and how many posts a month, quoted as one fixed monthly fee. Ad spend, if any, is separate and paid to the platform. All the content and source files are yours.

tools.note: We post on them. We aren't partnered with any of them, and nobody's badge is on our wall.

faq.a: Usually Instagram and LinkedIn, plus TikTok when your audience is really there. We'd rather do two properly than five badly.
Yes, in your voice, with your input on anything technical. You approve everything before it goes out.

faq.q: Do I need paid ads as well?
faq.a: Often, a little. Unpaid reach is limited on most platforms now. We'll tell you whether your goals are realistic without any spend.
You do. Designs, source files and captions are handed over, and they stay yours if we stop working together.

cta.p: Send us your handle. We'll have a look and come back with thoughts, politely.
